## isva-p01-v01 — C1

**SUMMARY.** The maker — him praised, one God, Maheśvara. Bodies bespeak conscious cause, distinct-arranged — pots, like atoms. Conscious-urged fragments and fixed-meaning fragments survive around gaps. In the varied, the conscious alone is marked, maker-wise, use-resolved. Function-yoked bodies and worlds hold distinct array, never from mere matter. Makers proved prove the Lord's act; variety-knowers cannot be lordless. Neither potter nor Lord shows agreement — opposition or unprovedness would follow. Merely showing conscious-only pervasion — by thesis-force, some wise one is understood.

*Rasa: vīra (confidence) of stated proof — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: the inference stated in full dress, dilemmatized, then answered minimally — bare showing suffices. The vyabhicāri is wonder that less proves more. Nyāya-confidence turned toward a conscious Lord.*

## isva-p02-v10 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Fitness shows the higher self in eye and the rest, the way combination is seen for another's sake. Fire comes proved as khadira-wood through mere knowing, the way smoke proves from afar. The hetu is fenced to bare locus-form, refusing bare variety the particular's mark. Others sift reasons the same way in the pot's self. The mutual-fit whole stands rightly Lord-made. Helpers answer strangely — some joining with stuff — picturing effects by entering-as-other, like earth-saps. Outward-turned others cannot yoke form-variety. Fancied spread, named but unshown, orders nothing alone.

*Rasa: vīra (confidence) of marshalled examples — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: eye, fire, pot, helpers parade and each is turned. The vyabhicāri is wonder that mere knowing proves wood-kind from afar. Proof by examples, relished.*

**Inference.** The higher self shows in eye etc. by fitness, as combination seen for another's sake.

## isva-p05-v37 — C1

**SUMMARY.** Since intellect's arising stands unperceived by any spirit, no purpose follows — unspeakable, of spirit or of nature, though mind's motions come conditioned each in private ways. Will — how serve every soul? Give it to nature-in-general, and every soul turns all-knowing. One light would mix all shinings unless some One, in all undivided, keeps each apart. No world-plan makes seed put forth sprout; blind nature, kit and cause, brings green about — the wise join part to part, calling it spirit's purpose by courtesy. Granted — still, when purpose ends, the Root would churn its effects and never cease: sevenfold nature grants no release.

*Rasa: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn — The sthāyibhāva is reasoning-press: unperceived will failing, generic will exploding into omniscience, nature-alone churning without release. The vyabhicāri is astonishment at the One undivided holding all spirits. Press relished.*

## isva-p06-v46 — C1

**SUMMARY.** From change, that One is longed for by all spirits — yet body's change runs by nature. As before, why not for the deemed-freed? It occurs, yet joins him not. Done and need-free he stands alone — yet needlessness fits no spirit ever, nor mind. With need gone, no meeting again — yet minds are born in bodies still. If sense-bound nature, not karma's waning, mokṣa is mere nature on karma's prop. Knowers act from compassion — yet passionless, release is passion's waning. Drop the nature-view, unjust; bodies bespeak a knowing Maker. From patterned difference, flawless proof — laid on the Lord by self-entrusted hand, unshaken.

*Rasa: vīra (triumph) of the sealed proof — The sthāyibhāva is exultation: freed-spirit tests failing, mokṣa-into-nature absurd, compassion betraying passion — then abandonment, proof, aim. Triumph relished.*

**SUMMARY.** A thousand blazing reasons prove — yet not for minds astray; palm-held Maheśvara flees the fated, Jewel slipping away. Your own Self flashes — Īśvara in every breather's heart, Maker and Knower — yet Recognition stands apart; we wrought its joining elsewhere, and in duality too it stands — fit, and fuller: midnight fire burns brighter in our hands.

*Rasa: śānta-adbhuta of closing praise — The sthāyibhāva is wonder: thousand-proved yet ungrasped, palm-held yet fled — and Self flashing within every breather, midnight fire. Closing marvel relished.*

**Premises.**

**Inference.** Proof needs fitness; the jewel flees the fated.

## isva-p07-v56 — argument map

**Speaker.** Utpaladeva (signature)

**Question.** Who shines within — and who signs?

**Premises.**
- One's own self indeed — this — flashes forth: Īśvara within all breathers (svātmaivāyaṃ sphurati sakalaprāṇinām īśvaro'ntaḥ).
- Maker and knower too (kartā jñātāpi ca).
- Yet recognition of the beyond is to be effected (yadi paraṃ pratyabhijñāsya sādhyā).
- And the joining is made by us elsewhere (sā cāsmābhir vihitaghaṭanānyatra).
- But Īśvara-proved stands even in duality (kiṃ tv īśasiddhir dvaite'py asti).
- Fitting, and more: fire shines at midnight (ity ucitam adhikaṃ bhāti vahnir niśīthe).

**Inference.** Self is Īśvara within all; the proof stands even dualist; signature and forward glance.
